title: How I Packed Carry-On Only For My Winter Holiday | Travel Tips
speaker: Flight Centre

cues.text: Hey there.
cues.en: Hey there.
cues.zh: 嘿。

cues.text: My name is Vicki and I'm going to show you how to pack light for winter by taking carry on only for a winter holiday
cues.en: My name is Vicki and I'm going to show you how to pack light for winter by taking carry on only for a winter holiday
cues.zh: 我叫 Vicki，我將向您展示如何在冬季輕裝上陣，只在寒假期間攜帶行李

cues.text: for one week.
cues.en: for one week.
cues.zh: 一週。

cues.text: Firstly, why travel carry on only for your winter trip.
cues.en: Firstly, why travel carry on only for your winter trip.
cues.zh: 首先，為什麼旅行只適合冬季旅行。

cues.text: It'll save you time at the airport.
cues.en: It'll save you time at the airport.
cues.zh: 這會節省您在機場的時間。

cues.text: You won't have to line up for check in.
cues.en: You won't have to line up for check in.
cues.zh: 您無需排隊辦理登機手續。

cues.text: You can just check in on your phone and have your boarding pass and go straight through to security.
cues.en: You can just check in on your phone and have your boarding pass and go straight through to security.
cues.zh: 您只需透過手機辦理登機手續並領取登機證即可直接透過安檢。

cues.text: You won't have to wait for your bag at the other end when everyone else is waiting at the luggage carousel.
cues.en: You won't have to wait for your bag at the other end when everyone else is waiting at the luggage carousel.
cues.zh: 當其他人都在行李輸送帶處等待時，您無需在另一端等待行李。

cues.text: You could just breeze straight through.
cues.en: You could just breeze straight through.
cues.zh: 你可以直接輕鬆透過。

cues.text: There is no chance that the airline is going to lose your luggage because you have it with you.
cues.en: There is no chance that the airline is going to lose your luggage because you have it with you.
cues.zh: 航空公司不可能遺失您的行李，因為您隨身攜帶行李。

cues.text: And it's just so much easier to pack light with less stuff.
cues.en: And it's just so much easier to pack light with less stuff.
cues.zh: 而且用更少的東西輕裝上陣要容易得多。

cues.text: When you're travelling domestically in your own country or internationally,
cues.en: When you're travelling domestically in your own country or internationally,
cues.zh: 當您在自己的國家或國際旅行時，

cues.text: there are general rules about things that you can and you can't take on your carry on luggage.
cues.en: there are general rules about things that you can and you can't take on your carry on luggage.
cues.zh: 對於隨身行李中可以攜帶和不能攜帶的物品有一般規定。

cues.text: For example, You can't take anything sharp, whether it's international or domestic.
cues.en: For example, You can't take anything sharp, whether it's international or domestic.
cues.zh: 例如，你不能拿任何鋒利的東西，無論是國際的還是國內的。

cues.text: So things like scissors, but even small items like tweezers,
cues.en: So things like scissors, but even small items like tweezers,
cues.zh: 像剪刀這樣的東西，甚至像鑷子這樣的小東西，

cues.text: you can't take on the plane.
cues.en: you can't take on the plane.
cues.zh: 你不能帶上飛機。

cues.text: Then if you're travelling internationally, there are restrictions on the amounts of liquids that you can take.
cues.en: Then if you're travelling internationally, there are restrictions on the amounts of liquids that you can take.
cues.zh: 如果您進行國際旅行，則可以攜帶的液體數量受到限制。

cues.text: So you can only take items that are under 100 mls in liquid.
cues.en: So you can only take items that are under 100 mls in liquid.
cues.zh: 因此，您只能攜帶 100 毫升以下的液體物品。

cues.text: So that includes your hand creams, any make-up that you take, water bottles, all that kind of stuff.
cues.en: So that includes your hand creams, any make-up that you take, water bottles, all that kind of stuff.
cues.zh: 這包括你的護手霜、你用的任何化妝品、水瓶，所有類似的東西。

cues.text: One tip is, though, that if you are traveling internationally, you can take an empty water bottle on the plane with you.
cues.en: One tip is, though, that if you are traveling internationally, you can take an empty water bottle on the plane with you.
cues.zh: 不過，有一個提示是，如果您出國旅行，可以在飛機上攜帶一個空水瓶。

cues.text: So I recommend doing this because most airports around the world have a water refill station.
cues.en: So I recommend doing this because most airports around the world have a water refill station.
cues.zh: 所以我建議這樣做，因為世界上大多數機場都有加水站。

cues.text: So this also applies to your make-up, moisturisers, all of that kind of thing.
cues.en: So this also applies to your make-up, moisturisers, all of that kind of thing.
cues.zh: 所以這也適用於你的化妝品、保濕霜等等。

cues.text: When I travel, I don't wear a huge amount of makeup, but I still do make sure that I have room
cues.en: When I travel, I don't wear a huge amount of makeup, but I still do make sure that I have room
cues.zh: 當我旅行時，我不會化很大的妝，但我仍然會確保我有空間

cues.text: for a liquid eyeliner, a lipstick, and I take my skincare products
cues.en: for a liquid eyeliner, a lipstick, and I take my skincare products
cues.zh: 買眼線液、口紅，還有保養品

cues.text: like my Gua Sha, my vitamin C, face oil, all of that kind of stuff.
cues.en: like my Gua Sha, my vitamin C, face oil, all of that kind of stuff.
cues.zh: 例如我的刮痧、維他命 C、臉部油，所有這些東西。

cues.text: And I always take a reusable makeup remover.
cues.en: And I always take a reusable makeup remover.
cues.zh: 我總是帶著可重複使用的卸妝液。

cues.text: Plus I always have my sunscreen, deodorant, and I also take a small aerosol dry shampoo so that it saves space.
cues.en: Plus I always have my sunscreen, deodorant, and I also take a small aerosol dry shampoo so that it saves space.
cues.zh: 另外，我總是帶著防曬乳、除臭劑，而且我還帶了一個小氣霧乾洗洗髮水，這樣可以節省空間。

cues.text: On international flights, you will also need to put your toiletries into a clear toiletries bag or clear plastic bags
cues.en: On international flights, you will also need to put your toiletries into a clear toiletries bag or clear plastic bags
cues.zh: 在國際航班上，您還需要將洗漱用品放入透明洗漱用品袋或透明塑膠袋中

cues.text: like these.
cues.en: like these.
cues.zh: 像這些。

cues.text: Now, for the hardest part.
cues.en: Now, for the hardest part.
cues.zh: 現在，最難的部分。

cues.text: How do you pack for cold weather when you're travelling with just a carry on suitcase?
cues.en: How do you pack for cold weather when you're travelling with just a carry on suitcase?
cues.zh: 當您只攜帶隨身行李箱旅行時，如何在寒冷的天氣收拾行李？

cues.text: Dimensions of approved carry on suitcases around the world are pretty standard.
cues.en: Dimensions of approved carry on suitcases around the world are pretty standard.
cues.zh: 世界各地認可的隨身行李箱的尺寸都是相當標準的。

cues.text: So it's 56 by 36 by 23 centimeters in dimension in diameter.
cues.en: So it's 56 by 36 by 23 centimeters in dimension in diameter.
cues.zh: 所以它的直徑尺寸是 56 x 36 x 23 公分。

cues.text: So that's 22 by 14 by nine inches.
cues.en: So that's 22 by 14 by nine inches.
cues.zh: 也就是 22 x 14 x 9 英吋。

cues.text: If you're in the imperial system, the weight of the suitcase in your carry
cues.en: If you're in the imperial system, the weight of the suitcase in your carry
cues.zh: 如果您採用英制系統，則您隨身攜帶的行李箱的重量

cues.text: on luggage, however, does vary depending on where you're travelling.
cues.en: on luggage, however, does vary depending on where you're travelling.
cues.zh: 然而，行李方面的規定會根據您旅行的地點而有所不同。

cues.text: If you're travelling domestically in Australia or New Zealand or out of Australia and New Zealand,
cues.en: If you're travelling domestically in Australia or New Zealand or out of Australia and New Zealand,
cues.zh: 如果您在澳洲或紐西蘭國內旅行，或從澳洲和紐西蘭出發，

cues.text: you're generally only allowed to take seven kilograms, which is about 15lbs, only carry on luggage.
cues.en: you're generally only allowed to take seven kilograms, which is about 15lbs, only carry on luggage.
cues.zh: 一般情況只能帶7公斤，也就是15磅左右，只能隨身攜帶。

cues.text: If you're travelling in Europe or the UK, for example, it depends on the airlines.
cues.en: If you're travelling in Europe or the UK, for example, it depends on the airlines.
cues.zh: 例如，如果您在歐洲或英國旅行，這取決於航空公司。

cues.text: So Air Lingus I think is like eight kilograms, Easyjet's 15.
cues.en: So Air Lingus I think is like eight kilograms, Easyjet's 15.
cues.zh: 所以我認為 Air Lingus 大約是 8 公斤，Easyjet 是 15 公斤。

cues.text: So you always need to check with your airline how much weight you're allowed to take if you're travelling in the USA on the other hand, that many airlines
cues.en: So you always need to check with your airline how much weight you're allowed to take if you're travelling in the USA on the other hand, that many airlines
cues.zh: 因此，如果您在美國旅行，您始終需要向航空公司核實您可以攜帶多少重量，另一方面，許多航空公司

cues.text: don't actually have restrictions on how much your carry on luggage weighs.
cues.en: don't actually have restrictions on how much your carry on luggage weighs.
cues.zh: 實際上對隨身行李的重量沒有限制。

cues.text: All they care about is you can lift your own bag and come down into the overhead locker above you.
cues.en: All they care about is you can lift your own bag and come down into the overhead locker above you.
cues.zh: 他們所關心的是您可以提起自己的行李並進入頭頂上方的儲物櫃。

cues.text: So it's always best to check what airline you're travelling with and what their restrictions are.
cues.en: So it's always best to check what airline you're travelling with and what their restrictions are.
cues.zh: 因此，最好檢查您乘坐的航空公司及其限制。

cues.text: Now to the good part.
cues.en: Now to the good part.
cues.zh: 現在到了好的部分。

cues.text: How do you pack for cold weather with carry on luggage only?
cues.en: How do you pack for cold weather with carry on luggage only?
cues.zh: 寒冷的天氣如何攜帶隨身行李？

cues.text: Tip number one, plan your outfits.
cues.en: Tip number one, plan your outfits.
cues.zh: 提示第一，計劃你的服裝。

cues.text: For this trip.
cues.en: For this trip.
cues.zh: 為了這次旅行。

cues.text: I'm going for eight days, including a day of skiing.
cues.en: I'm going for eight days, including a day of skiing.
cues.zh: 我要去八天，其中包括一天滑雪。

cues.text: I already know my itinerary, so it's really easy to plan my outfits
cues.en: I already know my itinerary, so it's really easy to plan my outfits
cues.zh: 我已經知道我的行程，所以規劃我的服裝真的很容易

cues.text: in advance, including what I'm going to wear in any evenings, active wear for hiking and for skiing.
cues.en: in advance, including what I'm going to wear in any evenings, active wear for hiking and for skiing.
cues.zh: 提前，包括我晚上要穿什麼，徒步旅行和滑雪時的運動服。

cues.text: I choose base layers and then long sleeve items as well,
cues.en: I choose base layers and then long sleeve items as well,
cues.zh: 我選擇打底衣，然後是長袖單品，

cues.text: so that I can mix and match with my clothes from day to night
cues.en: so that I can mix and match with my clothes from day to night
cues.zh: 這樣我就可以從白天到晚上與我的衣服混搭

cues.text: by simply changing a sweater or shoes, depending on what I'm doing.
cues.en: by simply changing a sweater or shoes, depending on what I'm doing.
cues.zh: 只需根據我在做什麼，換一件毛衣或鞋子即可。

cues.text: And this way I don't pack more than I need.
cues.en: And this way I don't pack more than I need.
cues.zh: 這樣我就不會打包超出我需要的東西。

cues.text: Tip number two.
cues.en: Tip number two.
cues.zh: 秘訣二。

cues.text: Use packing cubes or compression bags.
cues.en: Use packing cubes or compression bags.
cues.zh: 使用包裝立方體或壓縮袋。

cues.text: Tip number three.
cues.en: Tip number three.
cues.zh: 秘訣三。

cues.text: Roll your clothes.
cues.en: Roll your clothes.
cues.zh: 捲起你的衣服。

cues.text: Number four.
cues.en: Number four.
cues.zh: 第四。

cues.text: Stuff, smaller items into bigger items.
cues.en: Stuff, smaller items into bigger items.
cues.zh: 將較小的物品塞進較大的物品中。

cues.text: and five.
cues.en: and five.
cues.zh: 和五個。

cues.text: Wear your bulky items on the plane.
cues.en: Wear your bulky items on the plane.
cues.zh: 在飛機上攜帶大件物品。

cues.text: But you don't need to do this.
cues.en: But you don't need to do this.
cues.zh: 但你不需要這樣做。

cues.text: and this is how you pack it all together.
cues.en: and this is how you pack it all together.
cues.zh: 這就是將它們打包在一起的方式。

cues.text: Simply stack your packing cubes, add your toiletries in, squishing
cues.en: Simply stack your packing cubes, add your toiletries in, squishing
cues.zh: 只需堆疊您的包裝立方體，新增您的盥洗用品，壓扁

cues.text: your bulky items and zipper up and go!
cues.en: your bulky items and zipper up and go!
cues.zh: 將您的大件物品拉上拉鍊即可帶走！

cues.text: Those are my tips for packing carry on only for a winter trip.
cues.en: Those are my tips for packing carry on only for a winter trip.
cues.zh: 這些是我為冬季旅行攜帶行李的建議。
